replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body: Start building little structures, such as shacks or small houses, and then grow your skill by building more complex structures, such as a school or an apartment building, and continue until you have detail and a good build ideas.

replies.author: MerlinMaster
replies.body:
It's not the same building style for every map. Such as Walls and Nexus (Very different preparations to make). I have made a map for about every gamemode on Avicus.
Walls is a little harder than they seem. I can see where you are coming from. The walls needs a server to build on because, it needs to be copy and pasted in every quadrant.

replies.author: Shadowbladz
replies.body:
Ask better builders to comment on how you could improve the map.

Try to give multiple viable options for play, don't make your map coverless, but don't make it a pain to traverse.

I personally got lucky by being friends with a fairly well known OCN map maker, and a guy who actually makes a lot of money by building stuff. So I can just ask them how i could make it better.

3) Start with a map layout!
